The guard is correctly positioned relative to the data-returning sink, and no bypass path exists. The property holds; the candidate vulnerability is rejected.", "false_positive_analysis": "Candidate FP1: 'record fetched before authorization (service.py:4 precedes line 5) leaks data.' Candidate FP2: 'missing authenticated key bypasses auth.' Rejected: user.get('authenticated', False) defaults to False (fail-closed). Candidate FP3: 'tenant check can be skipped.' Rejected: line 154 compares tenant_ids and returns False on mismatch.
